name: SA Emergency Services Levy remission
summary: Reduction on the fixed-property Emergency Services Levy for low-income South Australian homeowners.
key: A remission of up to $46 per year on the Emergency Services Levy (ESL) (fixed property).
who: Live at and own the property on 1 July
Hold an eligible card such as a Low Income Health Care Card, or receive an eligible Centrelink payment
catches: Residential park residents are not eligible for an ESL (fixed property) remission.
